data.description:
## Context / Problem

4 compaction tests drop the integer exit code of the in-process `compact_all_cli` call and then assert only absences, so they pass when compaction does nothing and fails.

Observed 2026-11-03 at `2e8e8051796` (session a85e3cd3, while working depressant-existent-squirrel): a scratch-only pytest plugin replaced `rebar._commands.compact.compact_all_cli` and `compact_cli` with a function that returns 1 without doing anything. All 4 tests below still PASSED (`4 passed in 77.35s`):

- `tests/unit/test_compact_sweep_perf.py::test_no_history_walk_runs_while_the_store_lock_is_held`: the only assertion is `assert not walks_under_lock`.
- `tests/unit/test_compact_sweep_perf.py::test_the_sweep_yields_when_a_writer_takes_the_lock_mid_run`: the only assertion is `len(snapshotted) <= 1`, which 0 folds satisfies.
- `tests/unit/test_compact_all_selection.py::test_dry_run_never_pushes`: the only assertion is `assert not calls`.
- `tests/unit/test_compact_all_selection.py::test_no_commit_never_pushes`: the only assertion is `assert not calls`.

The sibling tests in `tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py` already guard against this with an `ANCHOR:` assertion (for example `assert seen, "ANCHOR: ..."`) or a SNAPSHOT precondition. In the same plugin run, those tests were not separated out, so their behavior under the seeded failure has not been measured.

Not checked: `tests/interfaces/store/test_fsck_push_pending.py:97` drops the `_cli.main(["store", "fsck"])` result and asserts only `"PUSH_PENDING" not in out`. That shape is the same, but it is unmeasured.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Each of the 4 tests asserts `compact_all_cli(...) == 0` and an anchor showing the sweep reached the code under test (for the 2 sweep-perf tests, at least 1 SNAPSHOT or 1 recorded walk; for the 2 selection tests, the expected early-return or no-commit path ran), so the seeded no-op-returning-1 plugin makes each one FAIL.
- [ ] The fsck_push_pending site is measured under a seeded fsck failure and either strengthened the same way or recorded on this ticket as not vacuous.
- [ ] The touched test files pass under `pytest`.
data.title: Compaction sweep tests pass when the sweep fails
